continuation_policy: If a pass returns before the measured Codex-subprocess wall-clock floor, launch another research pass over the same portable artifacts. Idle time between passes is excluded. The harness cannot distinguish useful work from waiting inside a running subprocess, so checkpoints and artifact audits remain mandatory.
completion_policy: A promising lemma does not end an iteration early. Use the remaining time to attack its assumptions, equality cases, counterexamples, and transfer to the RPCD complexity target.
